caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metal container with a handle on top, a spout protruding from its upper left side, and a large, curved side handle attached vertically along the right. The container's surface features evenly spaced perforations arranged in a grid pattern over most of its body, with horizontal bands at the top and bottom. The metal is depicted in shades of gray and brown, with areas of rust and discoloration, suggesting an aged appearance. The handle on top is arched and attached by two posts, with a small loop at the crown of the lid. The cylindrical form is rendered against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. Near the bottom right, there is an inscription with the text "Edward L. Lopez Del. 1970-1" in small, neat handwriting.
title: Milk Warmer
